terms.definition: The body's control center, made of billions of neurons.
terms.function: Thinks, senses, moves, feels, and remembers.
terms.whyItMatters: It runs everything the body does.

terms.function: Handles thinking, sensing, and voluntary movement.
terms.whereItIs: Top and sides of the brain.
terms.whyItMatters: It is where most conscious thinking happens.

terms.definition: The region at the back of the brain that coordinates balance and movement.
terms.whereItIs: At the base, at the back.
terms.whyItMatters: It makes coordinated skills like riding a bike possible.

terms.definition: The stalk connecting the brain to the spinal cord.
terms.function: Runs automatic life functions like breathing and heartbeat.
terms.whyItMatters: It keeps life functions going without conscious thought.

terms.definition: A nerve cell that sends and receives signals.
terms.function: Carries information around the brain and body.
terms.whyItMatters: Neurons are the wiring that makes the brain work.
